checkin: Thank you for booking your SAIL-a-bration with New Orleans Yacht Experience. We look forward to having you onboard. Leave behind your high heels, boots and snazzy dressy shoes. They can be dangerous and may also mark up the boat deck. Athletic shoes, boat shoes, or sandals are ideal. Be sure to inform your guests.
cancellation: Cancellation Policy All charter fees, with the exception of our exclusive “Vows on the Bow” wedding sails, are fully refundable up to 7 days prior to departure for any reason. You must call or email us 7 days prior to departure for a full refund. Within 7 days there is a reschedule option, but no refund. There is no refund and no reschedule if cancellation is within 24 hours of departure.
policies: Simply give us a call, and we will process your refund.
Cancellation due to weather is at the sole discretion of the captain at the time of departure.
We do not cancel based on extended forecasts, as conditions in our area change frequently—many rainy forecasts turn into beautiful sailing days.
We cancel very few experiences due to poor weather.
